name: Challenge: Help dialog absorbs destructive shortcuts without moving selection or consuming artwork history
description: Exercise the compiled local PixiBun build through user controls. Use a desktop viewport. Compare actual artwork and persistent state, not only element visibility. Missing prerequisites or unobservable cancellation must be reported rather than silently skipped.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /studio.
Verify restoration has finished and the main drawing canvas is editable.
Select the Pen tool.
Draw a short horizontal stroke in the upper-left quarter of the drawing canvas, away from its borders.
Draw a separate short vertical stroke in the lower-right quarter of the drawing canvas.
Verify both strokes exist with transparent space between them; remember their positions and shapes for later comparisons.
Select Box Selection and drag a rectangle enclosing the upper-left stroke but excluding the lower-right stroke.
Verify a selection boundary or transform gizmo encloses only the upper-left stroke; remember its bounds.
Focus the workspace and press Shift+/ to open Atelier Guide & Shortcuts.
Verify the help dialog is open.
Focus Close dialog inside the help dialog.
Press Control+z, Control+Shift+z, Control+s, e, Delete, ArrowRight and Shift+h while focus remains inside the dialog.
Verify Help remains open, both strokes and selection bounds remain unchanged, and Box Selection remains selected underneath the dialog.
Press Escape once.
Verify only Help closes; the original selection and both original strokes remain.
Focus the workspace and press Escape to clear the selection.
Verify selection decoration is gone and both strokes remain unchanged.
Click Undo.
Verify only the lower-right vertical stroke disappears; the upper-left horizontal stroke remains unchanged.
Click Redo.
Verify both strokes exist with transparent space between them; remember their positions and shapes for later comparisons.
